name: Continuous Breath Weapon (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Breath weapon, Sweeping Breath Weapon

Benefit(s): Three times per day you may take a full-round action to breathe a continuous spray of your breath weapon. This attack affects anyone within a semi-circle with a radius equal to the length of your standard breath weapon. The attack deals only half damage to anyone within its area, and continues to affect the area until the end of your next turn, during which time you may take no other action. Creatures within the area must move out of it as their first action or suffer the effects of the breath weapon again on their turn. Anything entering the area of effect during the round also suffers damage from the breath weapon; this includes missile weapons and other projectiles.
